reviews.text:
The renewed colors are a lot cooler than the first generation colors. That's a really pleasant surprise and I also love how slim the packaging has become. I bought a second shade because of it.
The old packaging was too bulky I had to remove them from the plastic for storage. I've included th color comparisons in the pictures. Top ones are the old shades and bottom oval ones are the new ones.
reviews.zh: 新版嘅顏色比第一代冷調好多。呢點真係令人驚喜，我亦都好鍾意新包裝變得更加纖薄。為咗呢個我買咗第二隻色號。舊包裝太大件，我要把產品從塑膠盒攞出嚟先收到入去。圖入面有顏色對比，舊色喺上面，新嘅橢圓形色號喺下面。

reviews.text: I had never used a shading palette until this one but I like it! As a newbie, I find that it’s super easy to use because it isn’t very pigmented! In that sense, it’s great because it’s buildable! It also seems very easy to blend! I love you doyoung 💚
reviews.zh: 我之前從來冇用過陰影盤，直到呢款。用落幾鍾意！作為新手，佢唔算好顯色，所以超級易上手！從呢個角度睇，可以一層層疊加呢點真係好正！推開都好容易！愛你 doyoung 💚

reviews.text: 일단 가장 많이 쓰는 기본 쉐딩 컬러만 다 써버리는 일이 생기지 않도록 비율을 1:2:1로 만든 점이 너무 좋은 것 같아용 컬러도 자연스러운 그림자 컬러고 발색도 진하지 않고 연하게 올라와서 쉐딩하기 쉽습니당 사진은 빛 때문에 좀 더 웜하게 나온 거 같은데 실제로는 더 쿨하고 붉은기 빠진 컬러들이에요. 발색샷 찍으려고 여러 번 덧바른거라 실제 발색은 사진보다 훨씬 연하고 자연스럽게 올라갑니다
reviews.zh: 首先，將用得最多嘅基本陰影色調做咗 1:2:1 嘅比例，等唔會咁快用晒其中一隻，呢一點我覺得好正。顏色係自然嘅陰影色調，顯色唔算深，輕輕咁上色所以好容易做陰影效果。相片可能因為光線睇落暖啲，但實際上係偏冷調、冇咩紅調嘅色。為咗影顯色相我疊咗好幾層，所以真實上色效果比起相片再淡啲、再自然啲。

reviews.text: The brush that came with the set is pretty good, although I wish the handle could be a little longer. The contour itself is pretty good, and the fan brush really helps to blend the shadows and make it look more natural.
reviews.zh: 套裝附送嘅掃幾好用，不過我希望支柄可以再長少少。修容粉本身唔錯，扇形掃真係有助推開陰影，望落更自然。

reviews.text: I have light medium skin tone and this was too light for me and not pigmented enough but it can be my fault for getting the lighter shade for reference I’m shade 03 for cushions. I’m not very pale as you can me so it’s my fault for getting a lighter shade
reviews.zh: 我膚色屬淺至中等，但呢款對我嚟講太淺，顯色度都唔夠。可能係我自己揀錯淺色嘅問題，畀大家參考，我 cushion 用 03 號。我都唔算好白，所以揀錯淺色號係我嘅錯。

reviews.text: Its a nice fine powder but doesn't create fallout or much excess powder when applying. I was hoping with this shade it would be a little more pigmented as the photos were however, I have to layer alot to get the same level of colour as the photos. It is a very very natural finish. The colour is also alot more yellow toned than expected, it seems to have a yellow base and I would recommend to those with a warm skin tone. I have a light neutral skin tone and I was surprised on how much on the warm side the colours were. For people who are beginners with shading I would highly recommend shade #03 as it suits all (medium to light) skin tones and has a natural finish and makes any makeup look nice. It is really easy to use and is lighter than the photos below (I had really bad lighting)
reviews.zh: 粉質幼細，用嘅時候唔會飛粉或者有太多多餘嘅粉。原本期望呢個色號可以好似相片咁顯色啲，但我都要疊好多層先去到相片嗰個效果。妝效好自然好自然。顏色比起預期偏黃調好多，似乎帶有黃色底調，會推薦畀暖調肌膚嘅人。我係淺色中性肌，個色偏暖令我好意外。對陰影新手嚟講，我會好推薦 03 號色，啱晒所有（中等至淺）膚色，妝效自然，任何妝容都夾到。非常易用，顏色比起下面相片再淺啲（我嗰陣光線好差）。

reviews.text: I bought Hazel grey set, really like the colour tone! I use this for my face contour as well as eye shadow. Love how natural it looks. The brush is very cute too, it is small and fit into my tiny makeup bag. Strongly recommend for girls who looking for natural makeup.
reviews.zh: 我買咗 Hazel grey 套裝，個色調真係好鍾意！我用嚟做面同眼影嘅修容。妝效自然我好鍾意。支掃都好得意，細細支剛剛好放入我個小化妝袋。強烈推薦畀鍾意自然妝嘅女仔。

reviews.text:
CC
I bought the Hazel Grey shade even though Im warm toned.
I dont like to heavily shade or contour and I mainly shade down the sides of my nose.

Before, I used Hoola Lite and for some reason warm tone shades as contour makes it look muddy. 🤷‍♀️

So I was on the search for coole toned shading product. 
This peripera one doesn't have the best color payoff tbh.
It's very subtle and can be layered for more color but I like it for that reason.

Its definitely on the greyer side so keep that in mind.
I sometimes mix Hazel Grey with Hoola lite.

*sorry if the nose pic startled you 😅
reviews.zh:
CC
雖然我係暖調肌，但都買咗 Hazel Grey 嗰隻色號。
我唔鍾意修容修得太重，主要係修鼻翼兩側。

之前用 Hoola Lite，唔知點解暖調色做修容會望落好混濁。🤷‍♀️

所以我一路喺度搵冷調嘅修容產品。
講真，呢款 peripera 嘅顯色度唔算最好。
好淡，可以逐層疊加再深色，但我鍾意就係呢一點。

佢的確偏灰調，記住呢一點。
我有時會將 Hazel Grey 同 Hoola Lite 溝一齊用。

*如果鼻嘅相嚇親你 sorry 😅

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
